title: Interface lemma source_activation_sound: coverage obligations to source soundness
intent: Reduce the global source-soundness theorem to the five local coverage obligations (entry, edge, call, combine, totality) by routing them through the activation_coverage locale: interpret the locale once, read the collecting cap off activation_collect_sound and the context witness off valid_activation_trace_has_context, then hand both to source_sound_from_collecting_cap. The proof sits entirely at the two abstraction boundaries, so no concrete analysis, domain or routing policy appears in it.

parent.name: source_activation_sound
parent.statement:
theorem source_activation_sound:
  fixes sg :: "pp \<times> 'c + 'g \<Rightarrow> 'a::numeric_domain abs_state"
    and adm :: "'c context_policy" and c\<^sub>0 :: 'c
  assumes wf: "wf_compile_input \<G> Pi ps"
    and s0: "s0 \<in> S"
    and run: "\<G>, Pi \<turnstile> (main_body Pi, s0, []) \<rightarrow>\<^sub>p\<^sup>* (residual, s, frs)"
    and ENTRY_G: "\<And>x. x \<in> S \<Longrightarrow> x \<in> \<gamma> (sg (Inl (cfg_entry (compile_prog Pi ps), c\<^sub>0)))"
    and EDGE: "\<And>u a v c x x'. (u, a, v) \<in> intra (compile_prog Pi ps)
        \<Longrightarrow> x \<in> \<gamma> (sg (Inl (u, c))) \<Longrightarrow> x' \<in> edge_step a x
        \<Longrightarrow> x' \<in> \<gamma> (sg (Inl (v, c)))"
    and CALL: "\<And>u dst pars args p cont c c' x.
        (u, CallEdge dst pars args, FunctionEntry p, cont) \<in> calls (compile_prog Pi ps)
        \<Longrightarrow> x \<in> \<gamma> (sg (Inl (u, c)))
        \<Longrightarrow> c' \<in> adm u c (call_info_of (CallEdge dst pars args) p) x
              (call_enter \<G> (CallEdge dst pars args) x)
        \<Longrightarrow> call_enter \<G> (CallEdge dst pars args) x \<in> \<gamma> (sg (Inl (FunctionEntry p, c')))"
    and COMB: "\<And>cl dst pars args p cont c1 c' p' x t es.
        (cl, CallEdge dst pars args, FunctionEntry p, cont) \<in> calls (compile_prog Pi ps)
        \<Longrightarrow> x \<in> \<gamma> (sg (Inl (cl, c1)))
        \<Longrightarrow> admits_call_context \<G> (compile_prog Pi ps) adm cl c1 p' x es c'
        \<Longrightarrow> t \<in> \<gamma> (sg (Inl (FunctionResult p, c')))
        \<Longrightarrow> combine_collect \<G> dst x t \<in> \<gamma> (sg (Inl (cont, c1)))"
    and TOTAL: "call_context_total_on (\<lambda>v c. \<gamma> (sg (Inl (v, c)))) adm \<G> (compile_prog Pi ps)"
  shows "\<exists>v stk t c. Pi, compile_prog Pi ps, prog_main_name \<turnstile> (residual, s, frs) \<approx> (v, s, stk)
                   \<and> activation_context_rel \<G> adm c\<^sub>0 (compile_prog Pi ps) t c
                   \<and> s \<in> \<gamma> (sg (Inl (v, c)))"

children.name: activation_collect_sound
children.statement:
theorem activation_collect_sound:
  assumes "activation_coverage g S cover adm c\<^sub>0 \<G>"
  shows "\<A>\<^bsub>\<G>,adm,c\<^sub>0,g,S\<^esub> v c \<subseteq> cover v c"

children.name: valid_activation_trace_has_context
children.statement:
theorem valid_activation_trace_has_context:
  assumes "t \<in> \<T>"
  obtains c where "carries t c"

children.name: source_sound_from_collecting_cap
children.statement:
theorem source_sound_from_collecting_cap:
  fixes sg :: "pp \<times> 'c + 'g \<Rightarrow> 'M"
    and \<gamma>\<^sub>M :: "'M \<Rightarrow> store set"
    and adm :: "'c context_policy" and c\<^sub>0 :: 'c
  assumes wf: "wf_compile_input \<G> Pi ps"
    and s0: "s0 \<in> S"
    and run: "\<G>, Pi \<turnstile> (main_body Pi, s0, []) \<rightarrow>\<^sub>p\<^sup>* (residual, s, frs)"
    and has_ctx: "\<And>t. t \<in> \<T>\<^bsub>\<G>,compile_prog Pi ps,S\<^esub>
                   \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>c. activation_context_rel \<G> adm c\<^sub>0 (compile_prog Pi ps) t c"
    and cap: "\<And>v ctx. \<A>\<^bsub>\<G>,adm,c\<^sub>0,compile_prog Pi ps,S\<^esub> v ctx
                       \<subseteq> \<gamma>\<^sub>M (sg (Inl (v, ctx)))"
  shows "\<exists>v stk t c. Pi, compile_prog Pi ps, prog_main_name \<turnstile> (residual, s, frs) \<approx> (v, s, stk)
                   \<and> activation_context_rel \<G> adm c\<^sub>0 (compile_prog Pi ps) t c
                   \<and> s \<in> \<gamma>\<^sub>M (sg (Inl (v, c)))"

applicability.goal_shape: A theorem whose assumptions are the local coverage obligations of a locale (here activation_coverage's INIT/INTRA/CALL/RETURN/TOTAL, supplied as ENTRY_G/EDGE/CALL/COMB/TOTAL) and whose conclusion is a global inclusion of concrete stores into the concretization of an abstract map; the proof must not mention any concrete domain, analysis or routing policy.
applicability.use_when: The obligations are already packaged as a locale (or a structure/interface), a separate lemma already turns a satisfying cover into the collecting cap (activation_collect_sound), and a second lemma supplies the existential context witness (valid_activation_trace_has_context); then the main theorem only interprets the locale and chains the two through a cap-consuming theorem.
applicability.avoid_when: The obligations are not yet packaged, so each must be discharged inline; the cap-consuming theorem's statement is too strong or too weak for the client (it fixes the concretization via gamma_state, so a non-numeric domain needs its own corollary); or the proof must mention a specific analysis or routing policy.

consequences: Creates no new obligations beyond those the locale interpretation discharges in one step (standard; blast intro: ENTRY_G EDGE CALL COMB TOTAL). The cost is two fixed points of contact: the cap lemma's cover parameter must match the interpreted locale (the lambda \<lambda>v c. \<gamma> (sg (Inl (v, c)))), and the cap-consuming theorem's concretization is instantiated to gamma_state. Failure modes: a domain or policy that does not fit gamma_state needs its own corollary (the file already has source_sound_toplevel_from_collecting_cap and source_sound_from_node_collect_cap for the other shapes); if the five obligations are renamed or reordered, the single interpret step stops matching.
